text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The 29th session of Baghdad international trade fair opens today (Friday).
- Cuba stresses its support for Iraq.
- A British official condemns his government's hostile stand against Iraq.
- France says the only solution to the Kurdish issue is through dialogue with Baghdad.
(The above stories were also carried by Thawra)
